description: On-street parking fines is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Data Mill North. Data files that contain fines issued for unauthorised parked vehicles in on-street locations. The data contains date, time, location, fine issued, discount available, and total paid. Local Government Transparency Code 2015 This is a key dataset which the government wants local authorities to publish. Coverage: United Kingdom. The portal files it under the publisher Data Mill North. It offers 62 resource(s) in CSV, XLS. The portal shows 2026-09-25 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
